subject: inorganic
question:
无机化学·配位化学：请判断下列配合物的几何构型：Bis(dihydrogen)ruthenium dihydride（RuH₂(η²-H₂)₂(PCy₃)₂）？
A. Octahedral
B. Trigonal prismatic
C. Square planar
D. Tetrahedral
explanation: Octahedral. Covalent count: Ru (group 8) 8 e; 2 × PCy₃ (L) 4 e; 2 × H (X) 2 e; 2 × η²-H₂ (L) 4 e: 18 e. Ionic count: the ligands carry a charge of −2 in all and the complex is neutral, so the metal is Ru(II), d⁶; d⁶ + 12 e from the ligands = 18 e. Two H are hydrides (X) and two H₂ are σ-complexes (L).
